subtopic: Conflicts of Interest and Standards of Conduct
source_evidence: conflicts of interest a broker or adviser may have; the required standard of conduct associated with the services a firm offers
answer: A client relationship summary (Form CRS) is a place to learn about conflicts of interest a broker or adviser may have and the standard of conduct required for the services the firm offers. Use these sections to understand what the summary says about the firm’s services, and compare summaries using their similar headings and topic order.
